svg.aria-label: Before: one plan, one key. Claude asks 'Here is the design. Proceed?' and you press Enter, approving it without reading. When it breaks, you do not know which choice broke it. After: you make each call. Each section opens with a card, Claude drafts 2 or 3 versions and you pick one, each choice becomes a decision record with the options you turned down, and each part on the review page has a Check yourself question.
